issues.description: Aufgabe 06: Spalten/Ergebnis-Mismatch between problem statement and solution. The problem statement (problem_statement.md line 133) requires the municipality name plus the male and female inhabitant counts (columns: name, einwohner_m, einwohner_w). The provided solution (solution_repository/aufgabe06.sql lines 1-3) selects only the name (SELECT name ...). This discrepancy means the solution does not satisfy the task specification and will confuse students and automated graders.
issues.suggestedFix:
Make the solution match the problem specification by returning the required columns. For example, update solution_repository/aufgabe06.sql to:
SELECT name, einwohner_m, einwohner_w
FROM Gemeinde
WHERE einwohner_m > 100000 AND einwohner_w > 100000;
If the intended exercise was to return only the name, update the problem statement to reflect that reduced requirement and adjust tests accordingly.
